notes.title: Free demo, Arabic text support, and a new Casual difficulty update!
notes.notes:
Did you say zombies?! A free demo of Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster is available now for new players to try catching the big scoop and survive the various dangers of the lavish Willamette Parkview Mall.

The latest title update adds Arabic text support and a new Casual difficulty for those who want to focus on uncovering the truth while dodging the zombie hordes.

Try the demo now!
